title: Revocation outage time
preconditions: a current permit has not expired but a required view reaches its exclusive freshness deadline
no newer usable view preserved continuous eligibility; the network attacker may delay messages but cannot forge trusted time
steps: Delay required revocation updates until a view expires; substitute client UTC or an incomparable evidence interval for trusted decision time; continue protected activity past the effective bound.
invariants: M1-015 V09: Strictest effective deadline and finite reevaluation contract bound stale acceptance; no claim of zero cross-service propagation delay
M1-015 F01: Revoked, expired, continuity-lost, unsupported and temporarily unavailable cases remain distinct and non-disciplinary
residual_risk: The proposed propagation bound assumes an honest authority and validated error/reevaluation bounds; unavailable is not proof of cheating.
Specified attack requirement only; runtime implementation and proof remain deferred.
